name: Semi-trailing arm rear (Skoda 130 RS measured geometry, Vondrak 2013)
source: Zdenek Vondrak, 'Konstrukcni navrh uhlove kyvadlove napravy' (Mechanical Design of Semi-Trailing Arm Suspension), Master's thesis, Brno University of Technology, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Institute of Automotive Engineering, 2013. Supervisor Ing. Petr Hejtmanek. Vehicle: Skoda 130 RS racing car rear axle. https://dspace.vut.cz/server/api/core/bitstreams/f3edc79f-1eab-4307-bfb1-9e6ea733b1a0/content. Left points of Tab.1 (photogrammetry, GOM TRITOP) at the measured, fully drooped pose; x is moved to the hub face point. The wheel offset is not given (wheel center = hub face point, assumed); radius 265 mm (thesis p.22). Masses and rates are assumed. Library model: the arm is turned about its pivot axis to 60 mm above the measured (fully drooped) pose, which is the design pose here, and the ground is moved to the contact height. Library model: the geometry is the validation model in tests/data/multibody/vut_semi_trailing; masses, spring and damper rates, and stops are assumed for the dynamics.

spring.note: coil-over on the damper points; rates assumed

camber_shim.note: inner pivot height (the 'up/down' variants of the source)

toe_link.note: outer pivot fore/aft (the 'forward/backward' variants of the source)

stops.note: the 120 mm damper stroke of the source: the droop stop at the measured pose
